title: STNFS with a retuned collection region and a charged work allowance: 2^122.252

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3964, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). The relation-collection region is retuned from theta=1/2 to theta=93/200 on the same A^2=2^21 lattice (a uniform sub-region of the certified sampled pool), leaving the relation margin at 0.3284 bits (above the model's 0.30 floor), and the sampled relation-collection work carries a 6% canonical-work allowance (4.66 measured standard errors of the 1933-row work mean, proof.md section 3) instead of an unqualified Monte Carlo point estimate. A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.252 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.250852. The two-log descent meter is retuned 2^119.4 -> 2^119.42 to keep success >= 0.39 after the smaller relation-weighted mean norms; no operation is dropped. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.252 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=93/200 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius 987, the 6% canonical-work allowance, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger, modelled_success and within_claim.
